gloss: seeing from a distance; long sight

definitions.gloss: seeing from a distance; a distant view
definitions.explanation: Looking at something from far away, or how it looks from far away. Most often in {遠目|とおめ}に and {遠目|とおめ}には (from a distance), and in {遠目|とおめ}にも, "plain to see even from far off".

definitions.gloss: long sight; ability to see far
definitions.explanation: Being able to see distant things well, mostly in {遠目|とおめ}が{利|き}く (to have keen long sight). The word can also mean long-sightedness as a condition, but {遠視|えんし} is the usual term for that.

examples.japanese: {遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To look at something from a distance.

examples.japanese: {遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: From a distance it looks real.
The house with the red roof was easy to pick out, even from far away.
A bird with keen long sight.
My grandfather has good long sight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠目|とおめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: He has sharp eyes for distance, so he spotted the little hut on the mountain at once.

notes:
⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ (far) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye, looking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ / {遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: from a distance
- {遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even from far away
- {遠目|とおめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to see well at a distance

USAGE:
{遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ often sets up a contrast: what looks fine from afar may not be close up ({遠目|とおめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧).
